Built from D2 tool steel with a thick, stone-washed blade, it’s designed for real outdoor use—from chopping kindling and camp work to food prep and cutting rope. Made one at a time by an independent maker, this is a purpose-built tool meant to be used and relied on.

watches.name: Raven Trekker - Vintage Blue - Steel Bezel
watches.description: Shipping Now The new version of the Vintage features a gloss navy blue dial and stainless steel bezel. The dial and hands are in the style of the original Raven Vintage which was first produced in 2012. This will be the first version of the Vintage to feature raised and polished indices and produced in steel and polished without the use of gilt or gold accents. The new Vintage is slimmer than previous models by reducing the crystal and case back which also reduces the water resistance to 200m but allows for a slimmer design. An automatic Miyota 9015 powers the Vintage and features a date window. The bracelet with quick release and adjustable clasp is 20mm and tapers to 16mm. Case: 39mm Lug to Lug: 48mm Bracelet: 20mm to 16mm with adjustable clasp Thickness: 12.5mm Water Resistance: 200m Movement: Miyota 9015/9039 Crystal: Box sapphire/AR coated Lume: SuperLumiNova Blue Dial: Gloss blue with polished indices Bezel: Stainless steel Price: $690
